title: BEST INFINITE CREEPER FARM 1.21! Minecraft Tutorial In 1 Minute!
description:
In This Tutorial, I Will Show you how to make the next generation of creeper farming inspired by the Gnembon module. It uses a new type of water system that works 1 by 1. How? It activates layers in a way that you will have space for spawning mobs while the mobs that got spawned in the first 6 layers are getting pushed, meaning working at a double or 200% efficiency rate and speed faster than any creeper farm you have ever seen before in Minecraft!

I hope to Enjoy My Video !!🙏🥰
